email-footer: Sent by { $brand }. Questions? Read the Help Center or write to { $help_email }.
email-ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
email-button-fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
email-for-profile: This message is for the profile { $profile }.
email-confirm-body: Welcome to { $brand }. Confirm this address to finish creating your account.
email-recovery-body: We received a request to reset the password of your account. Use the button to choose a new one. The link works once and expires soon.
email-code-body: Enter this code to continue. It works once and expires in { $minutes } minutes.
email-code-or-link: Or use the button to sign in.
email-change-body: You asked to change the email address of your account to { $new_email }. Confirm it with the button.
email-invite-body: Accept the invitation to create your account.
email-reauth-body: Enter this code to confirm that it is you. It works once and expires soon.
email-device-subject: New device signed in to your { $brand } account
email-device-body: { $browser } on { $system } signed in to your account { $where } on { $time }. If this was you, nothing more is needed. If it was not, change your password and sign out of all devices.
